pages.raw_title: About Us | Company and History | Cantaloupe
pages.raw_meta: At Cantaloupe, we're helping the world buy it and go with innovative solutions for self-service retail. Learn more about us.
raw_blocks: Cantaloupe is powering the evolution of self-service commerce across the globe.

With micropayment processing, enterprise cloud software, IoT technology, and point of sale innovations, Cantaloupe empowers businesses of all sizes to provide self-service experiences for consumers. We keep our customers ahead of the adoption curve – meeting them on location, partnering with them to grow in new markets, and helping them reach new customers.
Help the world buy it and go.
We aim to be the global technology leader ​powering self-service commerce.
We always put forth our best effort with our customer in mind.
We strive to improve ourselves.
We commit to getting the job done and getting it done right.
We communicate openly with others and keep our promises.
We work best as a team.
We look forward, to the future.
We solve problems with innovative solutions.
We are not satisfied with the status quo.
We work together to identify and implement solutions.
We empower eachother to do our best work.
We find strength in our different backgrounds and perspectives.
We know there’s more than one way to solve a problem.
We approach our work with creativity and determination.
Are you ready for the future of self-service? Then you should partner with Cantaloupe.
Join the team that’s shaping the future of self-service retail.
We’re guided by some of the brightest minds in business.
